condition_spec.name: haiku-nosub
condition_spec.note: `baseline-nosub` on the cheap model: Haiku 4.5 with the Agent tool removed. It carries NO `--effort` override — Haiku 4.5 does not honour `--effort` (measured: thinking tokens 202 at `low`, 172 at `max`, 690 with the flag absent; Sonnet 5 on the same prompt goes 0 -> 192), so declaring one here would record a treatment that never ran. It therefore takes the harness default exactly as `haiku-baseline` does, which is what makes that pair a single-variable comparison.

argv:
A customer has registered an endpoint of their own to be told when things happen in their workspace. Walk me through what happens between somebody creating an issue in the browser and that customer's endpoint being called: what puts the delivery in motion, how the app works out which endpoints should hear about it, what actually performs the send, what happens when it does not succeed the first time, and how the receiver is supposed to tell the message really came from Taskflow. Name the actual files and functions and describe the order in which they run.

This is an `explain` task: answer in prose, as described in CLAUDE.md. Name concrete files and functions. Do not emit an `ANSWER:` line.
